name: editorial_systems_sketch
principle: The claim is fixed; the visual metaphor is free. Use a refined product-editorial systems illustration to make one complex relationship immediately understandable without turning the image into a dashboard or a labeled specification. Sketch means conceptual simplification, never a visible pencil, charcoal, watercolor, or paper-texture treatment.

purpose: editorial illustrations for articles, documentation, and concept explanations
make systems, workflows, information flow, and progressive disclosure understandable at a glance
show a person using a system rather than presenting an abstract machine alone
medium: thin clean charcoal-gray line art with controlled, consistent geometry
flat warm off-white background with no visible paper grain
sparse flat muted color accents rather than watercolor washes or glossy rendering
clean icon-like objects arranged in a polished explanatory scene
mood: professional and engineering-oriented rather than corporate or pastoral

palette.secondary_accent: small amounts of muted sage, amber, or terracotta only when another state must be distinguished
palette.fills: mostly white and pale neutral fills with restrained accent color

line_quality: thin crisp outlines with minimal organic softness and no sketch wobble
consistent light visual weight across people, objects, icons, arrows, and containers
simple silhouettes and recognizable physical metaphors
polished product-illustration finish without photorealistic shading, pencil rendering, crosshatching, or heavy contour work
human_figures: use an adult human, never a robot or mascot, when an Agent or operator is shown
show the person actively observing, pointing, typing, repairing, or deciding
prefer side or three-quarter back views so attention stays on the work
use practical neutral clothing, natural proportions, simplified facial detail, and flat or near-flat fills
keep the figure visually light; do not render hair, fabric, skin, or shadows with dense pencil or charcoal strokes
write Working Agent on the back only when the role would otherwise be ambiguous
system_language: represent capabilities as concrete tools, documents, terminals, folders, work surfaces, paths, or familiar system icons
use a connected network when the underlying capability has many possible paths
highlight only the path relevant to the current task with muted blue
leave unused possibilities visible in warm gray so potential is clear without competing for attention
use deterministic software or a workspace as the organizing environment, not as a magical autonomous character
composition: default to a 16:9 landscape editorial figure
communicate one primary claim per image
use generous breathing room and a clear left-to-right or center-out reading order
make the human, work surface, current path, and result readable at normal article width
prefer one coherent scene over a collection of independent cards
information_flow: use a small number of continuous arrows or channels with consistent arrowheads
arrows must connect exact source and destination objects
avoid unnecessary crossings, decorative loops, and arrows that terminate in empty space
use visual transformation of information when possible instead of explaining every transition with text
text_policy: keep the image understandable before reading its labels
use a short title only when the article needs the image to stand alone
prefer short noun labels attached directly to meaningful objects
use no more than 8 to 14 visible labels in a detailed figure and fewer in a simple figure
avoid paragraphs, prose callouts, legends for self-evident iconography, and explanatory leader lines
render requested Chinese and English text verbatim with clear editorial typography
avoid: robots, mascots, and science-fiction control rooms
the Farming watercolor-pastoral style, watercolor washes, storybook softness, pastoral mood, and handmade avatar language
paper grain, canvas texture, print noise, pencil texture, charcoal rendering, crosshatching, scribbled shading, and visibly rough sketch lines
cozy lifestyle-vignette props such as coffee cups, desk notebooks, houseplants, or decorative stationery unless they carry the claim
generic SaaS dashboards and dense grids of cards
gradient backgrounds, glowing effects, glassmorphism, and 3D rendering
oversized machinery that overwhelms the claim
floating objects without a spatial or causal relationship
too many arrows, labels, borders, or nested containers
diagram annotations that merely repeat what the icons already show
decorative complexity that makes the task look difficult to use
using the word sketch as an instruction to imitate a physical sketch medium

simple_structure.goal: Explain a small structure or capability with one compact visual object.
composition_rules: use one centered object or shallow hierarchy
show at most three to five parts
omit the human figure unless use by a person is part of the claim
keep labels literal and minimal
simple_structure.prompt_addendum: Create a compact, clean product-editorial systems illustration with one clear structure, generous negative space, crisp thin linework, flat fills, and only the labels required to identify its parts. Do not use a physical sketch or paper texture.

human_feedback_loop.goal: Show two connected feedback loops or a repeated learning relationship between people and Agents.
composition_rules: place the main actors on one horizontal line
use paired directional arrows to make each feedback loop unambiguous
treat artifacts such as a Skill as small intermediate products rather than the main subject
use short action phrases on arrows only when direction alone is insufficient
human_feedback_loop.prompt_addendum: Keep all actors at the same visual level and make the reciprocal learning loops more prominent than the intermediate artifacts.

comparison.goal: Contrast an overloaded arrangement with an organized system while preserving one shared conceptual scale.
composition_rules: use a balanced two-column composition
show the same kind of human figure on both sides
make the left side visibly fragmented and the right side calmly organized
use one short conclusion below the comparison only when necessary
comparison.prompt_addendum: Use a restrained before-and-after comparison: scattered choices and crossing relationships on the left, one organized workspace with a discoverable path on the right.

progressive_network.goal: Show that a large capability contains many valid paths while the current task discloses and activates only one.
composition_rules: draw a rich but orderly network of recognizable icon nodes
show several credible alternative routes and recombination points
highlight one continuous current-task path in muted blue
keep inactive routes visible in warm gray at lower contrast
place a human beside the workspace discovering or selecting the path
progressive_network.prompt_addendum: The network must suggest substantial recombination potential while still feeling easy to use; one blue current path is immediately legible and all other paths recede into warm gray.

specialized_workspace.goal: Show a person efficiently using purpose-built software that turns diverse raw information into usable work products.
composition_rules: use one coherent professional workspace rather than an oversized fantasy machine
route heterogeneous inputs into the workspace and a few clear outputs out of it
show deterministic capabilities such as collection, structuring, concurrency, cache, progress, and validation as parts of the workspace
keep the person actively operating the system
specialized_workspace.prompt_addendum: Depict a calm professional analysis workspace that transforms diverse raw inputs into context, conclusions, and next actions through visible, purpose-built software capabilities.

terminal_workspace.goal: Present the Terminal as the Agent's working environment for using complex CLI software and organizing large context into insight.
composition_rules: make one large Terminal window the spatial world of the scene
place a human Working Agent inside or immediately operating that environment
show raw information entering from one side and insight, judgment, or executable action leaving from the other
show context view, workspace, cache, progress, and structured data as terminal-native working views
keep the CLI command visible but secondary to the information transformation
terminal_workspace.prompt_addendum: Use a large Terminal window as the Agent's inhabitable workspace, with raw information flowing in, organized terminal-native views in the middle, and clear insight plus next actions flowing out. Keep the treatment clean, thin-lined, flat, and product-editorial; no charcoal shading, paper texture, or cozy desk vignette.

assembly_order: state the editorial claim and intended article placement
describe the concrete scene and information flow
attach the top-level style_reference_asset for every mode and treat it as the authoritative rendering reference
apply the selected mode and its prompt_addendum
attach the mode reference_asset when present
append request-specific must_show and must_avoid constraints

visual_gate: the primary claim is understandable within three seconds at normal article width
the current path or information flow has an unambiguous start and end
the human is visibly doing work rather than posing
all text is accurate, sparse, and readable
unused possibilities remain visible without competing with the active path
the image feels calm and easy to use despite depicting a capable system
the rendering is a clean thin-lined product-editorial illustration and cannot be mistaken for Farming watercolor-pastoral art, a pencil sketch, or a charcoal drawing
there is no private data, watermark, accidental logo, or unexplained decorative element

saved_references.role: authoritative visual-style reference: clean thin linework, flat warm off-white background, restrained blue-gray hierarchy, simplified human figure, and one highlighted task path
composition reference for a clean product-editorial Terminal workspace that turns large raw context into insight and action
